title: Reborn as the King of Hell: I Control the Book of Life and Death Episode 11 English Sub
description:
Reborn as the King of Hell: I Control the Book of Life and Death, 转职阎王，我执掌了生死簿, Lucifer Donghua, Chinese Anime Donghua Stream, Anime4i ( chinese anime | donghua 2026 ) 1st season All episodes English sub.
All tribes roar, their voices shaking the heavens—the era of universal job transfers has arrived. On Awakening Day, Li Yi awakens to the supreme Yin God profession: Yin Si Supreme. As the pages of the Book of Life and Death turn, the lifespan of all living beings falls under his control. When the Wheel of Reincarnation spins, the souls of the dead across all realms return to his command.
With one hundred thousand ghost generals and one million Yin soldiers under his rule, a single thought can decide life, and another thought can determine death. Above the heavens and across countless worlds, Li Yi stands supreme—his will is the will of heaven itself. But when alien races descend and massacre humanity, the tragic cries of the human race echo throughout the world. Breaking through the limits of his profession, Li Yi ascends as the Emperor of Fengdu, shaking the three evil gods of the alien races. The Lord of the Yin Division commands both life and death—and governs the fate of all beings. That battle shook heaven and earth.
In the end, Li Yi destroys the evil gods and the invading aliens, bringing peace and tranquility back to this war-torn planet.
